subject: Private deployment pricing options and platform fee amortization
messages:
From: Emma Liao <emma@medicore.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medicore.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Looking for pricing scenarios for private deployment (VPC / on-prem)

Jordan —

Thanks for the demo last week. Medicore is interested in a Private deployment (VPC-first, possible on-prem later) for our inference workloads (clinical summarization and retrieval rerank). Before we lock a date for an architecture review, procurement asked for three commercial scenarios we can present to finance:

1) 3-year commit (capex-friendly) with platform fee amortized quarterly
2) 24‑month hybrid (reserved capacity + metered overage) with an implementation retainer
3) Perpetual-style license with annual support (we understand this is rarer)

Key asks from our side:
- Example pricing for each option (platform fee, per-node/license, oncall/support tiers)
- Any migration credits or pilot fee waivers you can offer
- Typical SOW milestones and billing cadence (we prefer milestone invoicing)
- SOC 2 evidence and indemnity language for our legal team

Can you send a short note + term sheet we can share with procurement by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Liao
Director of Engineering, Medicore Health
emma@medicore.com
+1 415-555-0189

[Attachment: initial-arch-notes.pdf]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liao <emma@medicore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Looking for pricing scenarios for private deployment (VPC / on-prem)

Emma —

Appreciate the clear ask. I've pulled together three high-level scenarios and attached a short pricing-summary.xlsx for quick review. Highlights below so procurement has something to digest immediately:

Option A — 3yr commit (capex-friendly)
- Platform fee amortized quarterly (can be capitalized by customers)
- Discount: baseline 18% on platform fee + 12% on node licensing for 36‑month commits
- Support: Standard (business hours) included; Premium (24/7 oncall) as add-on

Option B — 24mo hybrid (reserved + metered)
- Lower upfront platform fee (40% of A) + reserved capacity discount on nodes
- Implementation retainer (one-time) or milestone-billed SOW
- Migration credit: typical 10% of first-year committed spend; we can be flexible for pilots

Option C — Perpetual-style license
- One-time license + annual support (18% of license value)
- Includes limited platform maintenance; full private control plane package as add-on

Pilot/promo: we typically offer a pilot waiver (platform fee waived for first 60 days) for product-qualified pilots. For a 24+ month commit we can shift to a 20% platform-fee credit in year one instead of waiver.

I attached a preliminary price sheet and a short term-sheet draft. If procurement wants, I can convert the draft into a milestone-billed SOW that maps to your preferred billing cadence. Karthik/Marissa — any notes on EMEA latency SLAs or air-gapped add-ons to include?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123

[Attachment: pricing-summary.xlsx]

On Sun, May 10, 2026 at 11:17 AM Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Emma —
> Appreciate the clear ask. I've pulled together three high-level scenarios...

Folks — forwarding an internal snippet that might help the negotiation:

- Play: Pilot waiver (platform fee waived up to 60 days) + the option to convert waiver into a year‑one platform credit if they convert to a 24+ month commit
- Typical concession band: up to 20% off platform fee year one for strategic healthcare customers with at least a 2yr commit
- Migration engineering retainer: we can offer a discounted rate card (30% off list) if they prepay a tranche that maps to SOW milestones

Notes for Jordan: If Medicore is asking for SOC 2 evidence, attach the SOC 2 package and point procurement to the audit redaction rules. For air-gapped/on‑prem we usually require an additional operations retainer and a security addendum. Suggest you propose a pilot SOW with milestone invoicing: 25% on kickoff, 50% on production rollout, 25% on handover.

Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks — attaching a short non-binding term sheet and a SOC 2 evidence bundle. Quick answers inline: 

- Term sheet will include the explicit amortization clause: "Platform fee is billable quarterly and may be capitalized by the customer per their accounting policies; Redwood will issue quarterly invoices."
- SOW: I will convert Option B into a milestone-billed SOW (25/50/25) and share a draft for review by EOD Wednesday.
- Migration credit: for Medicore we can offer a 15% migration credit (applied as an invoice credit against platform fee in year one) if you sign a >=24 month commitment.
- Pilot: propose a 60-day pilot waiver; if you convert to a 24+ month commit within 90 days of pilot completion we will apply a year‑one platform credit instead (20% of year‑one platform fee).

Next steps: I'll post the term sheet to DocuSign and share the HubSpot deal link. Recommend a short call Wednesday morning to walk procurement through the amortization language and SOW milestones.
